## What changes?

Describe the scientific, code, documentation, or provenance change.

## Why?

Link the issue, method assumption, or reproducibility problem this addresses.

## Verification

- [ ] Python sources compile.
- [ ] <code>python scripts/verify_ahp.py</code> passes.
- [ ] <code>python scripts/validate_metadata.py</code> passes.
- [ ] <code>python scripts/publication_audit.py</code> passes.
- [ ] New stochastic behaviour has a documented seed.
- [ ] Provider/version/licence notes were updated when data provenance changed.
- [ ] No restricted data, manuscript files, credentials, local paths, or private Earth Engine IDs were added.

## Visual change

If a figure or site layout changed, include a before/after screenshot or explain why none is needed.
